name: Update KasmVNC

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  update:
    if: github.repository == 'Second-Hand-Friends/kleinanzeigen-bot'
    # The merge job shares this lock so it cannot merge while this job replaces the PR head.
    concurrency:
      group: kasmvnc-update
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - name: Generate update token
      uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
      id: token
      with:
        client-id: ${{ vars.DEPS_UPDATER_CLIENT_ID }}
        private-key: ${{ secrets.DEPS_UPDATER_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        permission-contents: write
        permission-pull-requests: write

    - name: Check out current main
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        ref: main
        token: ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }}
        persist-credentials: false

    - name: Update pinned release assets
      id: update
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        gh api repos/kasmtech/KasmVNC/releases/latest > "$RUNNER_TEMP/kasmvnc-release.json"
        version=$(python3 scripts/update_kasmvnc.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/kasmvnc-release.json")
        echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    - name: Create or update the KasmVNC PR
      uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@15733dbdfeedb4f7fdb73d13c6f5ac83b710fab8 # v7.0.5
      with:
        token: ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }}
        base: main
        branch: chore/update-kasmvnc
        delete-branch: true
        add-paths: docker/image/Dockerfile
        author: "github-actions[bot] <41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>"
        committer: "github-actions[bot] <41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>"
        commit-message: "chore: update KasmVNC to ${{ steps.update.outputs.version }}"
        title: "chore: update KasmVNC to ${{ steps.update.outputs.version }}"
        body: |
          ## ℹ️ Description
          Update the Docker desktop to KasmVNC ${{ steps.update.outputs.version }}.
          Release: https://github.com/kasmtech/KasmVNC/releases/tag/v${{ steps.update.outputs.version }}
          Related issues: none.

          - Update the version, download URLs and SHA-256 pins together for AMD64 and ARM64.
          - Keep a single update PR; a newer release replaces the pending update.
          - The merge workflow checks the current commit's full Build result and repository rules.

          - [ ] Formatting passes (`pdm run format`); verified by CI.
          - [ ] Lint passes (`pdm run lint`); verified by CI.
          - [x] No user-facing configuration or documentation changes are required.

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
